assumption_status: Analyst-designed sensitivity cases, not management guidance, consensus estimates, historical calibration or probability-weighted forecasts.
valuation_basis: Latest completed raw close divided by eligible reconstructed TTM diluted EPS. Microsoft EPS removes the disclosed annual OpenAI investment gain. Future EPS growth includes all revenue, margin, financing and share-count effects; these components are not separately estimated.

companies.eps_adjustment_reason: Remove FY2026 EPS contribution from OpenAI investment gains; this is one disclosed adjustment, not a comprehensive normalized earnings estimate.
companies.business_evidence: FY2026 revenue $331.8bn, operating income $155.2bn and diluted EPS $17.95 including $0.67 OpenAI gains. Source dated July 29, 2026.
companies.political_bridge: Data-center conditions can increase delivered-power and construction costs or delay revenue conversion; useful contracted capacity can retain scarcity value. AI regulation affects particular deployments, not automatically all cloud sales.
companies.assumption_rationale: 8/14/20% EPS growth spans slower monetization, continuing demand conversion and stronger utilization. 22/26/30x tests valuation discipline around the observed normalized trailing multiple; no historical-percentile claim is made.
companies.decision_gate: Underwrite monetization, depreciation and power commitments together; require the central case to meet the return hurdle before adding.
companies.invalidation: Demand conversion, lease-adjusted investment or depreciation diverges materially from the underwriting case.

companies.eps_adjustment_reason: Reconstructed GAAP TTM EPS; not management's adjusted EPS.
companies.business_evidence: July 29 Q2 release reports 24% sales growth, 18% organic growth and 22.6% adjusted operating margin. These quarterly adjusted measures are not substituted for the TTM GAAP input.
companies.political_bridge: Permitting restrictions affect backlog conversion, installation timing, utilization and working capital. They do not establish cancellation of every equipment order or a national construction ban.
companies.assumption_rationale: 8/20/30% EPS growth tests delayed deployment, sustained expansion and strong execution. 30/40/50x imposes differing degrees of compression from the observed trailing multiple; these are explicit stress choices.
companies.decision_gate: A falling stock is not enough: test the growth needed to offset compression, and compare with project delivery and order conversion.
companies.invalidation: Backlog converts faster than assumed, or mix and margins support sustained earnings growth outside the scenario range.

companies.eps_adjustment_reason: Reconstructed GAAP TTM EPS; no hypothetical tariff refunds or complete one-off normalization.
companies.business_evidence: August 20 release reports 5.9% quarterly revenue growth and 2.6% US comparable sales growth. EPS growth assumptions also require margin, mix and share-count judgments.
companies.political_bridge: Affordability pressure can support traffic and trade-down while squeezing merchandise margins through wages, imports and cost pass-through. Defensive demand need not imply defensive share returns.
companies.assumption_rationale: 3/8/12% EPS growth spans cost pressure, steady mix improvement and stronger operating leverage. 24/30/36x tests valuation support independently of sales resilience.
companies.decision_gate: Require the earnings and multiple combination to justify the entry price; monitor merchandise margin and higher-margin ancillary businesses separately.
companies.invalidation: Mix, advertising or membership earnings sustainably expand profitability faster than assumed.

companies.eps_adjustment_reason: June-ended TTM EPS across the documented one-for-one holding-company reorganization; not midcycle earnings.
companies.business_evidence: July 31 release reports Q2 earnings $14.5bn and operating cash flow $23.6bn. This elevated quarter is not extrapolated mechanically.
companies.political_bridge: Gasoline and supply disruption can support upstream realizations but change refining margins, throughput, taxes and working capital. A political affordability response may reduce consumer prices through several routes.
companies.assumption_rationale: -15/0/12% EPS growth and 13/16/19x exit multiples test normalization, sustained cash generation and persistent scarcity. Downside deliberately combines lower earnings with compression, a stress rather than a fitted relationship.
companies.decision_gate: Assess normalization downside before increasing an energy hedge after sector outperformance; dividends would improve total return but are excluded here.
companies.invalidation: Supply, production mix or structural costs change enough to move sustainable earnings outside the cases.

companies.eps_adjustment_reason: Reconstructed TTM EPS; land and working-capital effects make cash FCF a separate diagnostic.
companies.business_evidence: July 21 results report a 20% cancellation rate versus 17% a year earlier and expectations of elevated incentives.
companies.political_bridge: Affordability depends on mortgage payments, incomes, supply and incentives. A change in Congress or lower Fed policy rate does not itself deliver lower mortgage rates or stronger buyer demand.
companies.assumption_rationale: -10/5/15% EPS growth spans persistent incentives, stabilization and stronger order/margin recovery. 10/12/14x captures valuation risk around the observed cyclical earnings base.
companies.decision_gate: Add only when order quality, cancellations and incentive expense support the earnings recovery required by the price.
companies.invalidation: Employment weakens, mortgage spreads widen or land/incentive costs overwhelm demand improvement.

companies.eps_adjustment_reason: Reconstructed GAAP TTM EPS; not full-year adjusted management guidance.
companies.business_evidence: July 16 release reports Q2 revenue $112bn and operating earnings $8bn. Reported full-year adjusted guidance is not the GAAP starting EPS used here.
companies.political_bridge: Reimbursement, utilization, enrollment and government-program implementation alter the payer/provider allocation. Group EBIT margin is not the medical cost ratio.
companies.assumption_rationale: -5/12/20% EPS growth and 16/20/24x test persistent pressure, partial recovery and strong execution. Cases depend on underwriting and cost normalization, not a direct translation of election odds.
companies.decision_gate: Demand evidence of sustainable cost and reimbursement alignment before treating sector-relative underperformance as political mispricing.
companies.invalidation: Medical utilization, reimbursement or business mix differs materially from the assumed recovery.

companies.eps_adjustment_reason: Reconstructed TTM EPS. No industrial EBIT-margin or cash-FCF measure is calculated for this bank.
companies.business_evidence: July 14 Q2 release discusses net interest income through balances and rates; loan demand, deposit pricing and credit costs remain distinct drivers.
companies.political_bridge: A lower policy-rate path can reduce funding expense while also changing asset yields, loan demand and credit losses. Congressional control is not a direct monetary-policy instruction.
companies.assumption_rationale: -5/5/10% EPS growth and 11/13/15x stress credit normalization, balanced growth and stronger execution. No bank FCF or zero-debt assumption is used.
companies.decision_gate: Test deposit pricing, loan growth and credit losses together; compare banks with distinct funding structures before using financials as a simple rate hedge.
companies.invalidation: Credit or deposit competition materially changes the earnings trajectory.
